title: When restlessness keeps scattering the heart under pressure
issueStatement: Movement is increasing, but clarity is not. Pressure exposes what the mind reaches for when it feels cornered.
centralInsight: Guru answers wandering with saint company, listening, and honest stillness. Pressure becomes revealing when the line is allowed to interrupt panic and performance.
practicalReflection: The mind settles less by roaming and more by right company. Choose better placement before choosing more movement.
actionPrompt: Choose better placement before choosing more movement. Use the line before the pressure decides the tone.
